digest.component_or_area: CLI registry and command dispatch system
propositions: Removed 13 duplicate literal policy frozensets and the explicit intercept selection ladder from _cli._main_dispatch; router now derives live policy sets from _registry.derive_policy_sets() as sole authority
Every intercept route (21 total) plus audit command carries lazy handler metadata and argv adapter; all dispatch flows through single _execute.execute entry point
Both gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py generators produce byte-identical output on second render; --check mode passes with no deltas
Per-family subprocess E2E behavior preserved with identical exit codes and output; init policies and confirmation/output sets unchanged from pre-cutover census
Module-size constraints met: _cli/__init__.py 340 LOC and _registry.py 754 LOC both under 800-line limit; lint, type, and complexity gates pass
No persisted ticket/event/bridge/binding format or data storage changes; code-only rollback restores old router via revert of code and generated artifacts
